name: O Porriño (Spain)
description: Blue field charged with a yellow castle between two ears of wheat beneath a gearwheel and compasses, with two white wavy vertical stripes at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of O Porriño; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: two ears of wheat flanking the castle
gearwheel and compasses above the castle
two wavy vertical stripes at the fly
